work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CXXVII 43448, synopsis 43451–43455 and Urban self-protocol 43457–43458 follow previous dating 43441–43445. Four sections proceed in order 43483→43491 and 43537→43546; the Congregation’s counsel in section 2 is reported within Urban’s own declaration, not an independently issued curial protocol. Retained title/reading notes 43485–43486 and 43539–43541 match the current text. Full/short dating 43578–43584 closes the act before independent CXXVIII 43587.
